## Project Purpose

The purpose of this project is to create a personal portfolio website using Express.js and Handlebars. The website introduces the student, presents technical skills, displays programming-related projects, and provides contact information.

## Required Pages

1. Home
2. About Me
3. Projects
4. Contact Me

## Main Technologies

- Node.js
- Express.js
- Handlebars
- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Git
- GitHub

## Design Goal

The website should look professional, simple, and modern. It should be easy to navigate and responsive across different screen sizes.
